{{Top|leg}}
'''Shosk'irid''' was a commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Commenting on the entry for the [[Stalker Armor M1-10]], Shosk'irid noted that the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]] excelled at crafting good [[Armor/Legends|armor]].<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
